in_sanskrit.name: Kashvika
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess Kali's Victory
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kashvika एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Kashi’ (Goddess Kali) and ‘Vik’ (victory). This name signifies the triumph of the divine Goddess Kali over evil.

in_hindi.name: Kashvika
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess Kali's Victory
in_hindi.long_meaning: Kashvika एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Kashi’ (Goddess Kali) and ‘Vik’ (victory). This name signifies the triumph of the divine Goddess Kali over evil.

in_tamil.name: Kashvika

in_telugu.name: Kashvika
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Goddess Kali's Victory
in_telugu.long_meaning: Kashvika ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Kashi’ (Goddess Kali) and ‘Vik’ (victory). This name signifies the triumph of the divine Goddess Kali over evil.

in_marathi.name: Kashvika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Kali's Victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kashvika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Kashi’ (Goddess Kali) and ‘Vik’ (victory). This name signifies the triumph of the divine Goddess Kali over evil.

in_bengali.name: Kashvika
